format: PS3 Virtual Memory Card export (.PSV): '\0VSP' header, PS2 save type 2, 95248 bytes, folder BISLPM-55096, 3 files, 94908 bytes of file data

title: THUNDER FORCE VI

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/ps2-card.py 'BISLPM-55096.PSV' -o OUT: reads the save with mymcplus 3.0.5 and writes OUT/Mcd001.ps2 (an 8 MiB card with ECC, formatted and filled by mymcplus) for lrps2/pcee2/pcsx2, and OUT/mc0/<folder>/ for Play!

converted.read_back: work/ps2/tools/mcfs.py lists every file with the size and SHA-1 put on the card; one-saves (1saves convert + inspect) reads the card and finds BISLPM-55096
converted.timestamps: what the save does not date is 2000-01-01 00:00:00 (JST, as a card stores it); the card's own root entries too
